units.source_text: 当时风俗：阴历十月内第一个亥日，大家做饼，名曰“亥儿饼”。

en.t: According to the custom of the time, on the first Day of the Boar in the tenth lunar month, people made cakes called Boar Child Cakes.
The cakes came in various colors.

units.source_text: 当时认为吃了这种饼可以消灾却病，子孙繁昌。

en.t: At the time, people believed that eating these cakes could ward off disasters and illness and bring prosperity to their descendants.

units.source_text: 至今有的地方还保存此风俗。

en.t: Even today, some places still preserve this custom.
